messages:
maria: quick flag 1: new user on the starter-playground node quickstart hit 402 on first API call. they followed the browser flow and connected a card in console but api still rejects.

maria: repro from their machine:
```bash
node quickstart.js 
# -> fetch POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/chat generate
# headers: Authorization: Bearer sk-live-...
# body: { model: 'gpt-lite', messages: [{role:'user', content:'hi'}] }
```

maria: response: 402 Payment Required, message: "workspace billing not active"

kevin: can you paste org id & user email? also did they use "Create workspace" in the UI or join an existing workspace?

maria: org: org_A9b...z1, user: trialdev@example.com. They clicked "Create workspace" then entered card -> console showed card last4=4242 and "billing: active" in UI.

eng-billing-bot: Billing webhook processed: invoice.payment_succeeded for cust_yyy at 2026-02-20T09:12:03Z. Mapping: billing_account_id=ba_3Qd... not linked to org org_A9b...z1.

lucy: ah here's the delta: for the starter-playground flow we create a temporary billing account and then link it to the org in a separate step. looks like the linking job failed for some customers if they closed the browser immediately after card entry. we've seen a few of those.

kevin: workaround for support: go to Settings -> Billing -> Advanced -> Link billing account and select the recent payment method (or run the admin link job).

maria: support ran the admin link and got this output:
```
$ redwoodctl billing link --org org_A9b...z1 --billing-account ba_3Qd...
Linking billing account... success. org billing status -> active
```

maria: after link, quickstart call returned 200 and model responded. user confirmed success.

lucy: I'll add a fix to the frontend flow to wait for link confirmation before showing "billing: active" and add a server-side retry for the link job. putting a ticket in prod-bugs and tagging @eng-billing to prioritize.

kevin: thanks, leaving note in the quickstart README about the potential transient and the support steps. summary: card may appear in UI before backend link completes; if API returns 402, run admin link or use a service token as temporary bypass.

maria: closing this thread, filing internal bug 9876. thanks folks :partyparrot:
